package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/util"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

func TestPulseDynamicFilters(t *testing.T) {
	wire, err := os.ReadFile("/tmp/pulse-more-discovery/input.protobuf")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	all := &tempopb.Trace{}
	if err = proto.Unmarshal(wire, all); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	rows := []*Trace{}
	for _, r := range all.ResourceSpans {
		row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, r.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].TraceId, &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{r}}, nil)
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
	opts := common.DefaultSearchOptions()
	engine := traceql.NewEngine()
	cases := []map[string]any{}
	for _, key := range []string{"name", "span:name", "statusMessage", "span:statusMessage", "instrumentation:name", "instrumentation:version", "event:name"} {
		for _, q := range []string{`{resource.service.name="worker"}`, `{resource.service.name="absent"}`, `{span.shared="span"}`, `{span.shared="absent"}`, `{resource.service.name=~"work.*"}`, `{span.shared=~"spa.*"}`} {
			tag, err := traceql.ParseIdentifier(key)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			set := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
			collect := traceql.MakeCollectTagValueFunc(func(v tempopb.TagValue) bool { set[v] = true; return false })
			fetch := traceql.NewTagValuesFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, r traceql.FetchTagValuesRequest, cb traceql.FetchTagValuesCallback) error {
				return block.FetchTagValues(ctx, r, cb, func(uint64) {}, opts)
			})
			if err = engine.ExecuteTagValues(context.Background(), tag, q, collect, fetch); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			vals := []*tempopb.TagValue{}
			for v := range set {
				v := v
				vals = append(vals, &v)
			}
			sort.Slice(vals, func(i, j int) bool { return vals[i].Value < vals[j].Value })
			found, err := engine.ExecuteSearch(context.Background(), &tempopb.SearchRequest{Query: q + " with (most_recent=true)", Limit: 1000, SpansPerSpanSet: 1000}, traceql.NewSpansetFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, r traceql.FetchSpansRequest) (traceql.FetchSpansResponse, error) {
				return block.Fetch(ctx, r, opts)
			}))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			ids := map[string]bool{}
			for _, tr := range found.Traces {
				if tr.SpanSet.Matched != uint32(len(tr.SpanSet.Spans)) {
					t.Fatal("clipped fixture")
				}
				for _, sp := range tr.SpanSet.Spans {
					ids[tr.TraceID+"/"+sp.SpanID] = true
				}
			}
			completeSet := map[string]bool{}
			for _, r := range all.ResourceSpans {
				for _, ss := range r.ScopeSpans {
					for _, sp := range ss.Spans {
						if !ids[util.TraceIDToHexString(sp.TraceId)+"/"+util.SpanIDToHexString(sp.SpanId)] {
							continue
						}
						switch key {
						case "name", "span:name":
							completeSet[sp.Name] = true
						case "statusMessage", "span:statusMessage":
							message := ""
							if sp.Status != nil {
								message = sp.Status.Message
							}
							completeSet[message] = true
						case "instrumentation:name":
							name := ""
							if ss.Scope != nil {
								name = ss.Scope.Name
							}
							completeSet[name] = true
						case "instrumentation:version":
							version := ""
							if ss.Scope != nil {
								version = ss.Scope.Version
							}
							completeSet[version] = true
						case "event:name":
							for _, e := range sp.Events {
								completeSet[e.Name] = true
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			complete := []*tempopb.TagValue{}
			for v := range completeSet {
				complete = append(complete, &tempopb.TagValue{Type: "string", Value: v})
			}
			sort.Slice(complete, func(i, j int) bool { return complete[i].Value < complete[j].Value })
			cases = append(cases, map[string]any{"target": key, "query": q, "raw": map[string]any{"tagValues": vals}, "complete": map[string]any{"tagValues": complete}})
			if wire, e := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf("/tmp/pulse-more-discovery/filtered-%02d.protobuf", len(cases)-1)); e == nil {
				got := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
				if e = proto.Unmarshal(wire, got); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				if !proto.Equal(got, &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{TagValues: complete}) {
					t.Fatal("public decoder mismatch")
				}
			} else if !os.IsNotExist(e) {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
		}
	}
	raw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err = os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-more-discovery/dynamic-filters.json", append(raw, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
